$comment: The cert-covered set: packages whose packages/<name>/cert/ covers the human checklist and has a recorded negative proof (prove-negative.mjs). Renovate may automerge non-major bumps only for these, and compat.mjs's ci-certified set (run by hand) reads this list. Not a publish gate: every publish needs its PR's green ladder-build run (docs/ladder-builds.md). Sync renovate.json with: node scripts/sync-ci-certified-renovate.mjs
